title: Peripheral, Driver & Device-Control Management for Enterprise Desktops (Intune)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (cross-domain endpoint troubleshooting/operations; diagnostic method + scripts, live-environment care).
Vendor/product-specific console internals are deferred to the vendor's official documentation; the Intune/Entra/Windows side is authored at exact click-by-click detail.
hook: Control the peripherals, drivers, and USB devices on every desktop
problem: Printers that won't map, a driver that breaks a fleet, and uncontrolled USB storage are daily desktop pain — and a compliance risk in regulated environments. This solution gives you a repeatable way to manage peripherals, drivers, and device control with Intune: deliver and update drivers safely, manage printer and peripheral connections, and control removable/USB devices — deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — how Intune manages drivers (Windows driver update management), peripherals/printers, and device control (removable-storage access), and the standard deployment model.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune enrollment, Entra groups, driver/printer sources, Defender device control prerequisites, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps to configure Windows driver update management, deploy printer/peripheral configuration, and set device-control (USB/removable) policy, assign to a named pilot, validate, and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — peripheral/driver/device-control discovery, per-device applied-state validation, a driver/peripheral/device-control coverage report, safe remediation of missing/blocked devices, and a target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates (driver current, printer mapped, USB policy enforced), plus Best Practices for staged driver rollout and exceptions.
short: Manage drivers, peripherals/printers, and removable-device control across enterprise desktops with Intune — safe driver delivery, peripheral connections, and USB policy — pilot-first and rollback-ready. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
